# 1716. Calculate Money in Leetcode Bank

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def totalMoney(self, n):
        """
        :type n: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        ans = 0
        s = 1
        while n > 7:
            ans += (s + 3) * 7
            n -= 7
            s += 1
        ans += (s + s + n - 1) * n / 2
        return ans
```
